title: Copper Keynote Presentation: Los Azules
gist: Member-only listing for McEwen Copper managing director Michael Meding's 15-minute copper keynote on the Los Azules project at Benchmark Summit 2026 London, tagged Argentina. No project data are disclosed.

themes.theme: Los Azules pitched to battery-materials audience

insights.claim: McEwen Copper managing director Michael Meding gave the copper keynote at Benchmark Summit 2026 London, a 15:15 presentation dedicated to the Los Azules project and tagged Argentina.

insights.so_what: Los Azules is being marketed to the battery and critical-minerals investor audience as a source of new copper supply from Argentina.
